name: 2 Seater Sling Bistro Set
material: 2*1 teslin fabrics, steel frame w/t powder coated. w/t yarn-dyed fabric cushion.
description: If you are looking for a stylish and comfortable bistro set for your garden, patio or balcony, the Sunburst Sling Bistro Set could be just what you need. With its sleek and modern design, this set is sure to impress. You'll love the deep-seated cushions that provide ultimate comfort, while the side table is perfect for enjoying coffee or cocktails in the sun. The natural-coloured frame and cushions will complement any garden decor and provide a relaxing place to unwind.
